scope: Read-only proof and stated-assumption review, not code execution or physical validation

findings.detail: Ordered-cluster Sylvester constants; projector derivative no factor2; modulo-scalar full Cartesian Coulomb derivative; v and hbar cancel correctly.
Rank5 projector applies to isolated projectile block after exact cross-support vanishing; full two-center degeneracies explicitly excluded.
Reviewer supplied exact gapped O(t^-2) perturbation with O(t^-1) population remainder; final theorem and author ninth test preserve necessity of derivative control.
L1 interaction limit, repeated Bohr frequencies, degenerate coherence, state-specific versus every-state criterion, and compressed-contraction old observable correctly distinguished.

limitations: Review makes no capture or production admission.
